title_card.title: Hagia Sophia was the largest cathedral.
title_card.subtitle: It kept the record for nearly 1,000 years.

caption:
Hagia Sophia remained the world's largest cathedral for nearly 1,000 years.

Completed in 537 AD in Constantinople, the massive domed structure held the record until the completion of Seville Cathedral in 1520. Its architectural engineering reshaped world history.
